dataSourceIdToRefreshOnComplete.description: The data source id of the component that opened the modal. Used to refresh component grid after backend functions complete.

monitorSettingsEnabled.description:
Boolean used to determine if the Monitor Settings form will be displayed in the Sensor Settings Modal
Disables updates and hides collapsable drawer if set to false

userHasPermission.description:
A calculated field that does a comparison against the user's active roles. If 'Reliability.LimitedModelUser.Role' is found, the user is deemed to have permission
In the negative case this field is also used to determine the showing of warning banners and messages. Relevant operational status form fields will be disabled.
